assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: hero image for Green GO, a bilingual Macau local discovery and sustainable living website. Generate one finished horizontal 3:2 illustration, not a collage or UI screenshot. Style: contemporary minimalist flat editorial illustration, crisp geometric cut-paper shapes, restrained rounded forms, no outlines or extremely fine lines, no photorealism, no 3D, no texture or gradients. Spacious sophisticated composition, human and welcoming rather than childish. Keep main subjects in central 65 percent so it also works in portrait crop. No text, letters, labels, logos, frame or watermark. Opaque background.
